exploratory_file_output.sink: regular temporary file, truncated for each run

exploratory_pty_output.warmup: generated corpus already cached; no separate explicit warm-up run
exploratory_pty_output.sink: PTY master drained immediately in 65536-byte reads; OPOST disabled; no terminal renderer

limitations: Individual per-run timings were not retained; installed-results.json contains medians and ranges, exploratory measurements only medians.
Exploratory file and PTY scripts ran inline and were not saved. Their results are transcribed from tool output, not reconstructed raw samples.
No corpus hash was recorded and temporary corpora were removed. Generator and source HEAD identify the recipe, not an immutable corpus artifact.
No CPU-time, peak-RSS, syscall counts, or actual screen-rendering measurements were obtained.
Recursive initial comparison sorts lines and does not establish traversal order.
ASCII warm-cache workloads do not establish full GNU or Unicode compatibility.

release_comparison.required_method: Rebuild unchanged 0.4.0 and optimized 0.4.1 in ReleaseFast; compare freshly timed artifacts. Historical 0.3.x measurements are supplementary only.
